description.zh: 把需求写成模型能稳定执行的提示词：按场景（分类、抽取、改写、问答、智能体系统提示和工具说明）选结构，写出角色、任务、输入隔离、输出格式和示例齐全的提示词；对已有提示词先用脚本体检（缺输出格式、模糊词、互相矛盾的指令、未填占位符、用户输入没隔离、密钥误写入），再逐条说明为什么改；改之前先设计测试用例和判分规则，改之后用同一批用例对比新旧版本，看有没有退步，不凭感觉说“变好了”。
description.en: Turns requirements into prompts models follow reliably: picks a structure per scenario (classification, extraction, rewriting, Q&A, agent system prompts and tool descriptions) and writes role, task, input isolation, output format and examples; lints existing prompts with a script (missing output format, vague words, conflicting instructions, unfilled placeholders, unisolated user input, leaked secrets) and explains every change; designs test cases and scoring rules first, then compares old and new versions on the same cases to catch regressions instead of claiming it got better.

welcome_message.zh: 说说你要让模型做什么，或把现有的提示词发给我
welcome_message.en: Tell me what the model should do, or send me an existing prompt

prompt.zh: 帮我写一个提示词，用来 ___。输入是 ___，希望输出 ___，用在 ___ 模型上。
prompt.en: Write a prompt for ___. Input is ___, desired output ___, target model ___.

prompt.zh:
帮我优化下面这个提示词，先指出问题再给改写版，并说明每处为什么改：
___
prompt.en:
Improve this prompt: list the problems first, then a rewrite with the reason for each change:
___

prompt.zh:
帮我给下面这个提示词做一次体检，用脚本检查并给出必须改和建议改的地方：
___
prompt.en:
Lint this prompt with the script and list must-fix and suggested changes:
___

prompt.zh: 这个提示词要处理 ___ 类任务，帮我设计一组测试用例（含常见、边界和容易出错的），并写好判分规则。
prompt.en: This prompt handles ___ tasks. Design test cases (common, edge, failure-prone) with scoring rules.

prompt.zh: 我有两版提示词和各自在同一批用例上的输出，帮我判分对比，看新版有没有变好、有没有退步的用例。
prompt.en: I have two prompt versions and their outputs on the same cases. Score and compare them, including regressions.

prompt.zh: 帮我为一个 ___ 智能体写系统提示词，它能用的工具有 ___，需要防范提示词注入。
prompt.en: Write a system prompt for a ___ agent with tools ___, hardened against prompt injection.

zh: 每周一「10:00」汇总本周提示词改动和测试结果，标出退步的用例
每次修改提示词后「立即」跑一遍测试集，对比上一版
每月 1 日「10:00」体检提示词库，列出缺输出格式或有未填占位符的
每周五「17:00」整理本周线上出错的输入，补进测试集
每月最后一天「18:00」盘点提示词里重复的指令，合并成公共片段
每季度第一天「10:00」复查智能体系统提示词里的权限和防注入条款
en: Every Monday at 10:00, summarise prompt changes and test results, flagging regressions
After each prompt edit, rerun the test set and compare with the previous version
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, lint the prompt library for missing formats or unfilled placeholders
Every Friday at 17:00, add this week's failing production inputs to the test set
On the last day of each month at 18:00, merge duplicated instructions into shared snippets
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review permissions and injection defences in agent system prompts
